    A = params[0]
    B = params[1]
    damping_coeff = params[2]
    driving_force_coeff = params[3]  # Driving force based on the driving term you provided.
    
    acceleration = A * x ** 2  + B * v - damping_coeff * v - driving_force_coeff * (x - v)
